title: Marvel’s Spider-Man
tagline: Insomniac’s open New York, eight years into Peter’s career.
releaseLabel: PlayStation 4: September 7, 2018. PlayStation 5: November 12, 2020. Windows: August 12, 2022.
summary: Insomniac’s first Marvel game follows an experienced Peter Parker as Martin Li and a rebuilt Otto Octavius tear up the city. Miles Morales is part of the story and is not the lead player character. Marvel later placed this world on Earth-1048.
gameplay: Open-world web swinging, gadget combat, and suit crafting across Manhattan. Side missions sit between the story chapters.
